abilities.name: SWIFT ERASURE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each friendly unit that was picked to be a target of that SPELL ability and that is wholly within 12" of the Scinari Calligrave in this Regiment of Renown . On a 4+, that SPELL ability has no effect on that unit.

abilities.name: ARCANE TAXONOMY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove the Scinari Calligrave in this Regiment of Renown from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a friendly MANIFESTATION and more than 7" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUPPLIES DONT COME CHEAP
abilities.declare: Pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown . Each friendly unit wholly within 3" of that terrain feature is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, Heal (X) the target, where X is an amount equal to the roll.

abilities.name: NO ONE RIDES FOR FREE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY unit with up to 10 models that is wholly within 9" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: LONG-RANGE SUPPORT
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 15" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and that no friendly units are contesting . Each unit contesting that objective is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: SITE OF SLAUGHTER
abilities.effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be the amphitheatre .

abilities.name: FINISHING MOVES
abilities.effect: While each model in a unit in this Regiment of Renown is contesting the amphitheatre : That unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) . If you control the amphitheatre , if the unmodified hit roll or wound roll for an attack that targets that unit is a 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: HUNTER’S COHESION
abilities.effect: Each time this Regiment of Renown’s Lord-Aquilor uses its ’Ride the Winds Aetheric’ ability, you can pick all units in this Regiment of Renown that are not in combat to be the targets. In addition, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this Regiment of Renown’s Lord-Aquilor and VANGUARD-PALLADORS units that target a HUNTED enemy unit. Designer’s Note: See the ’Astral Compass’ ability on the Vanguard-Hunters warscroll to see how an enemy unit can become Hunted.

abilities.name: HOUR OF RETRIBUTION
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown . Add 1 to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: SPELL HUNTERS
abilities.effect: While both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range , enemy MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up within 12" of either of those units.

abilities.name: TOE TO TOE
abilities.effect: Subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy MONSTERS while they are in combat with any units in this Regiment of Renown .

abilities.name: GRIMNIR’S DEFIANCE
abilities.effect: Units in this Regiment of Renown cannot be picked to be the target of RAMPAGE abilities used by enemy units.

abilities.name: UNSTOPPABLE BATTLE FURY
abilities.effect: is unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: ‘I’LL GET THERE MYSELF!’
abilities.effect: This unit cannot be set up in reserve and cannot be targeted by abilities that would remove it from the battleeld.

abilities.name: INCUBATION PERIOD
abilities.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown .
abilities.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve festering within . They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: BURSTING WITH LIFE
abilities.effect: If a friendly non- NURGLE’S GIFT unit would be destroyed, before the last model is removed from play, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each other friendly non- NURGLE’S GIFT unit that has been destroyed this battle. On a 5+, pick a friendly unit that is festering within and set it up wholly within 6" of that model. It can be set up in combat .

abilities.name: PROJECTILE VOMIT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn. Then, pick a point on the battlefield within 6" of this unit and pick all other units (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: BELLOWING MOCKERY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn, then pick an enemy unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: WHAT’RE YOU LOOKIN’ AT?
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it charged this turn and has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn. Then, pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. This unit can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can pass through enemy models and must end that move in combat with the target.

abilities.name: JUSTICE WILL BE SERVED
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the Neave Blacktalon in this Regiment of Renown to be the target if it is in combat with an enemy HERO .
abilities.effect: The target can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. Each time it does so, if it is in combat with an enemy HERO , all of its attacks must target an enemy HERO . In addition, after the first FIGHT ability is used, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
